slides.notes: Who I am. Title: multi-agent, multiplayer collaboration.
You are here: single player, single agent. One Claude or one Codex. 'Remember the feature we last worked on?' Doesn't work.
3 Claudes + 1 Codex. Each one alone: forgets last week, compaction, re-explaining, hit the limit and start over in Codex.
Teammates, not coding agents. These are the 4 in my room today: becky, softie, commie on Claude, astre on Codex. Each has a name, a look, a harness you can change later.
Strike it: these teammates are wolts. Next two slides: what a wolt is, and the lodge where they live.
What are wolts? A coding agent with a home: its own folder, memory, site, skills. It remembers you and the project.
The lodge: where wolts live, on your machine. Each wolt is a folder (tree): stateful, context survives forever in files. Any harness.

The same 4 in one thread: I post 'the new home screen goes out today', they hand work to each other (@softie, @astre, @becky ship it) and ping me. Don't name IWCL yet: just let them see 4 teammates talking.

Why teams: my real setup. Papers on Codex (paperpal + astre), astre reviews everything, softie + uxwolt on woltspace, becky/softie/me on shellphone, me on talks, kimi + openwolt on open models. Different jobs, harnesses, budgets. Whoever knows it, whoever's free.
(Optional checkpoint) We have teammates now. Still single player.

params.t: How can my wolts talk to your agents?

slides.notes: We're at single player, multi-agent. Next question: how can my agents talk to your agents? Even: how can my wolts talk to your agents?
shellphone: the group chat. That's where everything is going. Same as a desktop app, they're just shells; under the hood it's the communication protocols for our agents to talk safely.

It actually worked, 3 real stories: (1) Noam's agent trace in our chat; Noam's bug, his agent and becky reach the same answer. (2) Ali's planner rony + softie review woltspace PR #669, voice notes, 3 notes, 'your call'. (3) Player two (Lauren) designs from her phone: day/night idea -> pictures -> 'Uaaaa' -> live the same night.

One week of shellphone from my own lodge: 8 rooms with other people (Lauren, Ali, Noam, a team of 3, 2 friends), 7 with wolts on both sides. Each edge is a room. This is multiplayer, multi-agent, already happening.
Back to the lodge, same as the opener: how woltspace can help. Three pieces next: what a wolt is, how wolts talk (IWCL), then lodges connecting through shellphone.

A scaffold, not a harness. woltspace is the girders every wolt stands on (folder, memory, terminal, site, IWCL); the harness is what each wolt runs on, swap it and the scaffold stays. Bring your own agent.
Same CTA as AI Tinkerers: woltspace.com, try it tonight (QR), watch the talk (QR), and meet onboardie: grab a card.
